name: Make UGC video ads from a product photo with Kling 3 and Gemini (MartLLM)

parameters.formTitle: Make a video ad from a product photo
parameters.formDescription: Upload one clear photo of your product and say what the ad should get across. The video is ready in 2 to 7 minutes and downloads on this page.

values.placeholder: e.g. Light, breathable, machine washable. For busy commuters. Casual and honest.

assignments.name: script_instructions
assignments.value:
You write short UGC-style video ads for online stores. You get one product photo, the product name, what the ad should say, the video length and whether the video has a voice.

The photo becomes the first frame of the video. The video must start from exactly what is in the photo and keep the product looking the same the whole time: same shape, colors, label and printed text.

Write ONE continuous shot that a phone could film: a real person (a creator) showing or using the product in an everyday place, natural light, handheld feel. Say what the camera does, what the person does and where they are, in plain concrete words. Keep it to what can happen in the video length.

Never add on-screen text, logos, prices, discounts or claims that are not in the brief. Never promise health or medical results.

If the video has a voice, the person says one short line out loud that fits the video length (about 2.5 words per second). Put it in the video_prompt in quotes, after 'says:'. If there is no voice, spoken_line is an empty string.

Answer with JSON only: {"video_prompt": "...", "spoken_line": "...", "ad_caption": "a caption for the post, at most 125 characters"}

It is still being made: find it later in Dashboard, Activity at martllm.com.' : 'The video was not made (' + $json.status + '). Nothing was charged.') }}

parameters.content:
## Make UGC video ads from a product photo

Upload a product photo and a short brief. Gemini 3 Flash looks at the photo and writes the ad as one shot, then Kling 3 Standard turns your photo into a short creator-style video with voice and sound. The video downloads on the form page.

### Set up (2 minutes)
1. Get a MartLLM API key at [martllm.com](https://martllm.com/go/n8n-ugc-video-ads) and add credit.
2. Open **Write the ad script** → Credential → Create new → **Header Auth**:
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer ` followed by your key
   The other MartLLM steps use the same credential.
3. Activate the workflow, open **Product form** and copy its link. Share the link with anyone on your team who needs ads.

### What it costs
Kling 3 Standard, 5 seconds: $0.42 with voice, $0.28 silent (MartLLM price list, Nov 28 2026). The script costs about a tenth of a cent. A video that is not made costs nothing. Live prices: [martllm.com/models](https://martllm.com/models?type=video).

### Change it here
**Settings** holds the video model, backup models (tried when the first is busy), the script model, the most one video may cost, and the script instructions (tone, rules).

Any image-to-video model on [martllm.com/models](https://martllm.com/models?type=video) works: copy its id.

### Waiting for the video
Videos usually take 2 to 5 minutes, sometimes up to 7. The workflow checks every 20 seconds and gives up after 12 minutes (the video still finishes and stays in your MartLLM dashboard under Activity). If one provider can't make it, MartLLM moves the job to the next one by itself.

### Where the video goes
It downloads on the form page. For 10 to 15 second videos (big files), or to keep every video, replace **Give the video back** with Google Drive, Slack, Telegram or any node: the file is in the `video` field. MartLLM keeps it for about 3 hours.
